summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 737,054 RSU awards (each representing one Class B Ordinary Share) to 302 employees under the 2021 Plan. The purchase price is nil; market price on grant date was HK$143.7 per share (HKEX) and US$18.06 per ADS (NASDAQ). Vesting is over 4 years in equal portions, with no performance target. This is a routine equity grant, not a special situation.
